data.heading: A palace of quiet on Lake Pichola
data.subheading: Thirty-two rooms, suites and pool villas in a restored 1884 haveli, a boat ride from the City Palace.

highlights.text: Best rate when you book direct

data.heading: A 19th-century haveli on the shore of Lake Pichola
data.description:
Built in 1884 as the lakeside home of a family of royal jewellers, the haveli has been lovingly restored by their descendants. Its arched corridors, frescoed walls and courtyards now welcome travellers from around the world.

We have 32 rooms, suites and villas, a spa, a rooftop restaurant and three acres of gardens — all a short boat ride from the City Palace.

items.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.answer: Check-in is from 2 pm and check-out by 11 am. Early check-in and late check-out are free when rooms are available.

items.question: Do you arrange airport transfers?
items.answer: Yes. A car from Udaipur airport costs ₹1,800 each way; from the railway station ₹900.

items.question: Is the hotel suitable for children?
items.answer: Yes — children under 6 stay free, and our Family Suite has two connected rooms.

items.question: Can I pay a deposit online?
items.answer: Yes. After we confirm availability, we send a secure payment link for a 30% deposit.

data.content: We use the details you give us — name, contact details, travel dates and preferences — only to answer your enquiry and manage your stay. As required by law, we record identity documents of guests at check-in. We never sell your information.

• A 30% deposit confirms your booking; the balance is paid at check-out.
  • Free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival.
  • Cancellations within 7 days, or no-shows, are charged one night.
  • For 15 October to 15 January, cancellations within 21 days are charged 50% of the stay.

Rates are per room per night, include breakfast and exclude GST unless stated.
